title: fix: reward merged quest PR authors
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Rewards the author of the first merged PR that closes a POLLEN-QUEST issue
- Removes issue assignment from eligibility and keeps open quests available to multiple contributors
- Updates contributor guidance and focused quest reward tests

Tests:
- `npm run typecheck --workspace pollinations-enter`
- `npx vitest run test/quests.test.ts`
- `npx biome check ...`

gist.headline: First bloom gets the pollen
gist.blurb: Quest rewards now follow the merged code, not an issue assignment. The first contributor whose PR closes a POLLEN-QUEST issue gets the Pollen, while the garden stays open for anyone ready to help.
gist.summary: Quest rewards now go to the author of the first merged PR that closes a POLLEN-QUEST issue, replacing issue assignment as the eligibility check and keeping open quests available to all contributors.
gist.impact: Contributors can pick up any open POLLEN-QUEST and know that the first merged solution earns its fixed Pollen reward.
gist.visual_concept: Depict an open community garden with several friendly contributor paths leading to one blooming quest flower; Polli, wearing a tiny gardener hat and holding a merge-shaped watering can, awards a glowing Pollen seed packet to the first successful gardener. Include a retro terminal showing a simple merged PR checkmark, with open flower beds signaling that quests are not reserved by assignment.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush and light blue wings, wearing a tiny gardener hat as she hands a glowing Pollen seed packet to a contributor beside a freshly blooming "QUEST" flower; a retro terminal shows a simple merged PR checkmark while several open garden paths and code-plants welcome more helpers. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley, with subtle pixel-font text: "FIRST MERGED".
